ai_summary: Aarti Industries Limited (AIL) has secured a significant 10+ year strategic manufacturing and supply agreement with an undisclosed global speciality chemical company, projecting an estimated revenue potential of ₹1,500 crores (US$150 million). This long-term contract, which requires AIL to set up a dedicated facility with less than US$25 million in CAPEX under a structured financial arrangement, is expected to commence operations in FY2028-29, notably expanding AIL's global customer base and strengthening its strategic manufacturing portfolio. While the partner remains undisclosed, this appears to be a material positive development for AIL with no immediate red flags.
